package.name: arm
package.description: The 3DOF delta arm package. A single ROS 2 package hosting the custom interfaces (SetPosition action, ArmPosition / MotorTargets messages, EmergencyStop / MotorParamQuery / TogglePositionStream services), the two-stage inverse-kinematics library, the task-space controller node (set_pos action / get_pos streaming), the manual-control (WASD) tool, the FashionStart UART-servo motor driver (fsuartservo + cserialport built from the checked-out submodule sources), and the arm simulators (SFML 2D + Gazebo 3D). The controller + driver can run tightly coupled in a single process (arm_system).
